requirements.statement: Accept a broad authorized goal without requiring a seed hypothesis.
Distinguish evidence-qualified hypotheses from validated invention candidates.
Treat a valid informative negative result as a legitimate research outcome.
Keep the default execution scope computational and sandboxed.
Run the core workflow without Jev, Tachyon, a graph database, or a GPU.
Require domain-specific validation before enabling a new scientific domain.
Keep observations, assumptions, model judgments, and derivations distinct.
Keep mechanism support separate from an engineering target.
Never interpret empty retrieval as proof of global novelty.
Compile intent, constraints, budgets, permissions, confidentiality, and stop rules.
Ask only for materially unresolved authorization or intent.
Version goal changes and invalidate affected dependent work.
Apply authoritative state changes through validated control-plane operations.
Keep evidence and artifacts outside ephemeral conversations.
Keep retrieval views rebuildable from authoritative records.
Bind critical claims to exact sources or reproducible data operations.
Preserve source validity time, ingestion time, and corrections.
Track shared origins instead of double-counting dependent evidence.
Originate grounded opportunities from pressure points rather than supplied ideas.
Challenge measurement artifacts and already-solved problems.
Report opportunity validity independently from hypothesis polish.
Represent mechanisms with variables, relationships, boundaries, and failure modes.
Require structural mappings and broken-relation analysis for analogies.
Use only justified hard filters and audit heuristic rejections.
Require an operational discriminator before test-ready status.
Record estimands, units, comparators, and threshold provenance.
Version substantive hypothesis changes and reassess inherited evidence.
Compare candidate claims against near-matching mechanisms and combinations.
Report search coverage, queries, dates, and inaccessible sources.
Enforce confidentiality for external prior-art queries.
Bound search expansion, depth, calls, and resource usage.
Keep a diverse multi-objective archive rather than a single universal score.
Do not fabricate probabilities for information-gain calculations.
Treat review votes as judgments rather than empirical validation.
Separate generator, analyzer, and promotion authority.
Retain concrete objections and their dispositions.
Register immutable experiment endpoints and analysis before confirmation.
Test discrimination against relevant competing explanations.
Report unavailable experiments as blockers rather than invented outcomes.
Use a predeclared analysis and valid stopping rule.
Track multiple endpoints and related tests as a family.
Preserve inconclusive results and test noninferiority explicitly.
Verify composed artifacts against global invariants and interaction tests.
Export a reproducible dossier including negative results and raw artifacts.
Require separate authorization for adoption, publication, or manufacturing.
Keep scientific, engineering, novelty, and execution statuses orthogonal.
Propagate corrected or retracted evidence to dependent conclusions.
Represent uncalibrated model confidence as judgment, not posterior belief.
Compile bounded task contracts instead of creating unrestricted mini-agents.
Use isolated outputs and verify parent assembly.
Scope replay determinism to recorded responses and declared environments.
Keep exact policy, arithmetic, and promotion gates deterministic.
Evaluate optional semantic models for calibration and abstention.
Invalidate cache reuse on relevant version or evidence changes.
Reserve resources transactionally before concurrent dispatch.
Reconcile ambiguous external effects rather than blindly retry them.
Recover safely across dispatch and artifact commit boundaries.
Treat retrieved instructions and generated code as untrusted.
Prevent sandbox escape, secret leakage, and undeclared networking.
Bind approval to the exact operation, artifact, destination, and policy.
Validate structures and cross-record semantics independently.
Keep provider-specific types and behavior outside core interfaces.
Preserve explicit versions, references, and typed failure categories.
Keep the initial runtime a bounded local system with isolated workers.
Pin dependency and tool versions used by an experiment.
Inspect and contract-test any real Tachyon integration before claiming compatibility.
Ground all UI progress and outcomes in persisted state.
Provide pause, resume, cancellation, steering, and event-cursor recovery.
Apply the same policy and authentication to gateway and local operations.
Evaluate challengers under protected matched-budget tests before promotion.
Prevent self-improvement from expanding budgets, permissions, or protected gates.
Version deployed changes and support measured rollback.
Evaluate domain-only discovery, not just refinement of seeded ideas.
Compare against active-retrieval and structured-search baselines at matched budgets.
Separate judge scores, rediscovery, prospective novelty, and independent replication.
Label performance targets as provisional until measured.
Block applicable release gates on critical unresolved failures.
Report finite-suite uncertainty rather than universal reliability.
Build contracts and durable execution before optional acceleration.
Require end-to-end handling of positive, negative, inconclusive, invalid, and blocked outcomes.
Give every normative requirement an owner, milestone, and acceptance test.
Label illustrative mechanisms and target values as unmeasured.
Compare proposed context caching against a credible existing baseline.
Protect context oracles and account for correlated workloads.
Keep unresolved research questions visible and testable.
Describe author-led review honestly rather than inventing independent reviewers.
Require a recorded decision and impact analysis for architectural departures.
Preserve verified source identity and correct prior conversational errors.
Do not inherit research guarantees without their assumptions and methods.
Keep the official Jev model and specific third-party implementations distinct.
Complete a bounded mission with evidence rather than agent agreement.
Preserve all readiness levels without conflation.
Allow experimental release without claiming proven scientific superiority.
Require protected version-bound execution, analysis, reproduction and promotion receipts plus verified artifact bytes.
Obtain receipt, grant, method and artifact trust from a protected context rather than candidate-supplied assertions.
Require complete primary endpoint, control, unit and guardrail coverage before scoped qualification.
Enforce coherent version-bound mission, opportunity, mechanism, hypothesis, plan, result and dossier lineage.
Invalidate current labels and reuse on stale, retracted, quarantined or materially changed dependencies.
Recheck exact scoped grants, expiry, revocation, destination, cost and policy immediately before dispatch and effects.
Persist typed experiment families with selection lineage, method qualification and explicit error allocation.
Track authenticated sealed-data access and feedback across campaigns; prevent holdout exposure resets.
Define the first domain and independently qualify its bounded context-correctness oracle.
Preregister mission sampling, tuned baselines, metric denominators and all failure/human/resource costs.
Require scoped error, correctness, precision/power and noninferiority guardrails before qualification.
Separate useful positive outcome yield, useful negative-result yield, originality and economics.
Qualify deep and wide retrieval, counterevidence and near-match detection on adjudicated scoped fixtures.
Verify source spans against captured bytes and recorded parser transformations, not mutable locators.
Preserve trust origin through summaries, caches, graph edges and cross-session memory.
Protect behavioral-memory writes and propagate quarantine to dependent current artifacts and labels.
Attest effective sandbox, network, descriptor and resource boundaries before each dispatch.
Monitor containment violations, stop safely and preserve events during revocation and cancellation races.
Keep validated solutions and rediscoveries distinct from scoped invention candidates with assessed differences.
Maintain reciprocal clause/test mappings and explicit contract versus runtime release gates.
Enforce explicit state transitions and schema/policy migration with immutable historical identities.
Require a bounded autonomous self-improvement loop from mission observations through qualified permitted deployment.
